topic: Difficulty can rise 300% or fall 75% in one adjustment
hook: Bitcoin's difficulty can jump 300% in a single adjustment.

scenes.narration: Difficulty is recalculated every 2,016 blocks, about two weeks.
At each adjustment it can rise by as much as 300%, or fall by as much as 75%.
The goal is to keep block time near ten minutes.
Higher difficulty means more attempts per block, so miners feel it.

cta: Did you know there were limits? Comment below, and the link is on my channel page.
title: Bitcoin Difficulty Can Jump 300% at Once
description_body: At each 2,016-block adjustment, difficulty can rise by as much as 300% or fall by as much as 75%.
